description: Replacement of double-glazed PVCu windows to front and side elevations with double-glazed timber casements.
decision_conditions: The development to which this permission relates must be commenced not later than three years from the date of this permission.
To comply with the requirements of Section 91 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 (as amended by Section 51 of the Planning and Compulsory Purchase Act 2004).

The proposed development hereby approved shall be constructed in accordance with the materials detailed under page 5 of the application form, unless otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority.
Reason: To ensure that the appearance of the proposed development will harmonise with the character of the surrounding area.

The development hereby permitted shall not be carried out otherwise than in complete accordance with the approved plans Location Plan, 200, Curved Living Room Window, Curved Doorset Sidelight (Lefthand), Abbotsbury Front Door, Curved Doorset Sidelight (Righthand), Curved Doorset Sidelight (Lefthand & Righthand) & Abbotsbury Front Door, Ground Floor & First Floor Bay, Facet T: Ground Floor Bay, Facets U & W: Ground Floor Bay, Facet V: Ground Floor Bay, Facet X: Ground Floor Bay, Facet T: First Floor Bay, Facets U & W: First Floor Bay, Facet V: First Floor Bay, Facet X: First Floor Bay, Study Window (Front), Landing Window (Side) (dated 04.09.2025).
Reason: For the avoidance of doubt and to ensure that the development is carried out as approved.

Statement Required by Article 35(2) of the Town and Country Planning (Development Management) Order 2015: No significant problems were identified during the consideration of the application, and therefore it has been determined in accordance with paragraph 38 of the National Planning Policy Framework.
